prose: A Bloomberg analysis indexed by Techmeme estimates the paper value of equity held by San Francisco AI-company insiders, including a per-employee calculation at an assumed Anthropic IPO midpoint. The full article was inaccessible. Its valuation assumptions and distribution of holdings could not be inspected, and estimated equity value is not realized cash or a typical employee payout.
highlights: Evidence is limited to an indexed excerpt
Figures are attributed to Bloomberg analysis
Average holdings need not describe a typical worker
Paper equity is not realized proceeds
